AddressEmptyCode(address).details: There's no code at `target` (it is not a contract).

ERC1967NonPayable().details: An upgrade function sees `msg.value > 0` that may be lost.

Upgraded(address).details: Emitted when the implementation is upgraded.

userdoc.notice: The proxy of the Sirocco mirrors on Sepolia (cTSLAx, cNVDAx, cAAPLx, cAMZNx). Each one         points at Zama's own `ConfidentialWrapper` implementation, the very contract behind         Zama's cUSDCMock, ctGBPMock and cXAUtMock, and is initialized the same way (no pauser,         no observers, deny-list off). Only the wrapped underlying and the owner differ.
